scripts.check: npm run check:frontend && npm run check:backend
scripts.check:frontend: npm --prefix frontend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.report:file-sizes: find frontend/app frontend/components -name '*.tsx' -type f -exec wc -l {} + | sort -nr | awk '$2 != "total" && $1 > 500 { print "WARN frontend >500 lines: "$0 }'; find backend/app/services -name '*.py' -type f -exec wc -l {} + | sort -nr | awk '$2 != "total" && $1 > 800 { print "WARN backend service >800 lines: "$0 }'
